The 2026 Motocaddy range

Every model in the range comes with a choice of battery: Standard for 18 holes, Ultra for 36. Pick the frame for the features you want (GPS, downhill control, remote), then the battery for how much golf you play. In-stock models are listed first.

02

Why we fit for free.

Most golfers play clubs built for an average swing. A fitting replaces the guesswork with your own numbers: we watch you hit, try heads and shafts from Wilson, Srixon, Mizuno and others on the launch monitor, and show you what changes.

It costs nothing and there is no obligation to buy. Leave with a recommendation, buy from us, or simply keep the numbers.
